items.t: Illumina Wins Virtual Cell Challenge, Powered by Billion Cell Atlas
items.sum: Illumina, Inc. (NASDAQ: ILMN) today announced that its BioInsight AI Lab won the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge, hosted by Arc Institute. The company's results were powered by data from Illumina's Billion Cell Atlas and a new cellular response prediction algorithm, CellularAI, which produced highly accurate predictions of cellular responses to genetic perturbations in unseen cell types.
